easyPrerequisites: An opponent must control either an artifact or creature depending on the card being donated.
description:
Cast Legerdemain by paying {2}{U}, exchanging control of an artifact or creature an opponent controls and Altanak.
Activate Soltari Guerrillas an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}, targeting Altanak.
Altanak triggers that many times, causing its controller to draw that many cards and lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.
